tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Madar Transport's facts: what it does and does not do, where it operates, what a price includes and excludes, how to book, the vehicle size by headcount, contact details (WhatsApp, phone, email), commercial registration and tax card. Start here.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Every service Madar offers (conference transport, bus rental, minibus rental, airport transfers, intercity trips, tour groups, church trips, weddings and events, sports teams, Hajj and Umrah groups, employee transport), each with a short description and its page URL.

tools.name: list_fleet
tools.description: Every vehicle size Madar hires out with its driver: seats, where the luggage goes, a description, photos and its page URL. Vehicles are hired whole, never by the seat.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: The cities and districts Madar serves (Mansoura and every Dakahlia district first, the Delta, Cairo, Alexandria, Sinai, the Red Sea, Siwa, Luxor, Aswan) and the Luxor/Aswan tour movements (temples, airports, cruise docks, Abu Simbel, Luxor–Hurghada), each with its page URL.

tools.name: recommend_vehicle
tools.description: Recommends the vehicle size (and how many) for a group from the headcount (every child counts as a seat) and the luggage, using Madar's own rule: HiAce up to 13, Coaster 14–21, midibus 22–33, coach 34–50, more vehicles above that; suitcases that must be locked away start at the midibus; foreign tour

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Keyword search over every page of madar-transport.com (services, vehicles, cities, Luxor/Aswan movements, FAQs). Returns titles, URLs and the matching line. Search in Arabic or English.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full text of one page of madar-transport.com (a service, a vehicle, a city or a Luxor/Aswan movement), by its URL or path, e.g. /en/fleet/toyota-coaster or https://www.madar-transport.com/ar/services/conference-transport.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends the traveller's trip to Madar Transport as a quote request (or a booking request with ready_to_book), with the traveller's own name and WhatsApp/phone — only with their permission. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_info, list_services, list_fleet, list_destinations, search_site, get_page · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: get_company_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_info, list_services, list_fleet, list_destinations, search_site, get_page · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: get_company_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
